title: Clean Accuracy Does Not Guarantee Provenance Robustness: A Prospective Codec-Stress Evaluation of Audio Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2609.07981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio provenance attribution - which system produced a synthetic utterance - is reported at near-ceiling accuracy on clean benchmarks, yet audio reaching an analyst has usually been transcoded. We report a prospectively registered measurement of closed-set attribution after single-stage codec transport, with the analysis region fixed from fidelity metadata before any attribution model was trained. On two corpora, in-support losses reach 53.5 [43.5, 63.6] and 70.3 [63.0, 77.5] Macro-F1 points for WavLM-Base+, and 61.0 [56.8, 65.1] and 49.8 [41.6, 57.9] for W2V2-BERT 2.0, under simultaneous component-level bands. Degradation is strongly condition- and representation-dependent: within one in-support grid WavLM losses run from -0.4 to +53.5 points, and the two encoders differ beyond a prespecified +/-5-point margin at six of twelve conditions. translated_title: 干净数据准确率并不能保证溯源鲁棒性：音频归因的前瞻性编解码器压力评估
translated_abstract: 音频溯源归因——即识别哪个系统生成了合成语音——在干净基准测试中被报告具有接近上限的准确率，然而到达分析师手中的音频通常已经过转码处理。我们报告了一项前瞻性注册的测量研究，考察单阶段编解码器传输后的闭集归因性能，其中分析区域在任何归因模型训练之前即依据保真度元数据予以固定。在两个语料库上，在同时施加的组件级条件频带下，支持集内的性能损失分别达到 53.5 [43.5, 63.6] 和 70.3 [63.0, 77.5] 个 Macro-F1 点（WavLM-Base+），以及 61.0 [56.8, 65.1] 和 49.8 [41.6, 57.9] 个点（W2V2-BERT 2.0）。性能退化强烈依赖于具体条件和表示方式：在同一个支持集内测试网格中，WavLM 的损失从 -0.4 到 +53.5 个点不等，且两个编码器在十二个条件中的六个上超出了预设的 ±5 点误差范围。经过干净数据认证的 ECAPA-TDNN 和 Proxy-Anchor 头表现出相当的退化程度，因此该效应并非局限于……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过前瞻性注册的编解码器压力实验揭示，在干净数据上表现近乎完美的音频溯源归因模型，在经过单阶段编解码器转码后性能损失可高达约70个Macro-F1点，且退化程度强烈依赖条件与编码器表示，证明干净数据准确率并不能保证溯源归因的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Through a prospectively registered codec-stress evaluation, this paper demonstrates that audio attribution models achieving near-ceiling clean accuracy can suffer losses of up to 70 Macro-F1 points after single-stage codec transcoding, with degradation strongly condition- and representation-dependent, proving that clean accuracy does not guarantee provenance robustness.
